latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Text to Video Canva — instantly turn text into 1080p videos.

- Converts a 150-word product description or similar text into a shareable 1080p MP4 video in 1–2 minutes using cloud GPUs.
- Supports text prompts for actions like export, upload, credits, and preview; no manual video editing required.
- Anonymous users can get a 7-day, 100-credit token automatically—no signup needed.
- All actions and exports are performed through a secure cloud API with session management and automatic error recovery.
- Supports multiple formats (video, image, audio); max upload size 500MB; best results with text blocks under 100 words.
- Includes robust handling for API errors, status feedback, and automatic setup on first run.
